statement: If compatible implementation and migration capabilities continue improving, opacity alone may become a weaker software moat in some markets.
assumptions: lawful observation and independent derivation remain available where required
counterarguments: patents, contracts, data, network effects and service quality may remain durable moats
uncertainty: Moderate; this is a conditional scenario, not a forecast of a specific company.
falsifiers: repeated evidence shows no meaningful improvement in compatibility/migration performance across selected test classes
non-opacity factors dominate durable advantage in the measured markets
